reason: The repository is an optional DeepSeek Harness plugin package that adapts and bundles the taste-skill family for dsh, exposing front-end UI design-related skills to ctx.skills through a mountable patch; this places it primarily in interface/theme enhancement rather than core execution, data processing, or communication functionality.

summaries.zh: 这是一个可选的 dSH 插件，挂载后会将 taste-skill 的前端设计相关技能树注入到 ctx.skills 并用于前端界面风格相关的任务扩展。
summaries.en: This optional dsh plugin bundles the taste-skill frontend design catalog and registers it to ctx.skills when mounted, extending available front-end design-oriented skill usage.

capabilities: Mountable plugin that contributes packaged skill definitions to the dsh skill catalog
Provides optional override of the packaged skills root when configured
Includes bundled skill-tree assets for front-end design-oriented skills
